doctrine: CATALOG LAYER ONLY (V2_PLAN.md decision 1). Master keeps its year-stamped variables and the CLAUDE.md storage doctrine is unchanged. This register is applied by the payload build and the unexposed-indicator screener. Reversible by editing the rule in scripts/build_year_family_groups.py and rebuilding.

family_tests.trailing_year: variable name ENDS in a four-digit year in [1500, 2100]
family_tests.infix_year: variable name carries a four-digit year in [1500, 2100] as an interior `_YYYY_` token (Phase 1b)

rule.safety_test: a stem is collapsible only if EVERY member has ALL of its rows at its own year
rule.cross_rule: the trailing rule owns a stem name outright; an infix family that reduces to a name the trailing rule already produces is refused
rule.dirty_stems_refused: melt artefacts and join-key suffixes (`__`, `_dept`, `_pcode`, ...) never become ids
